newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end largely flat, off highs on U.S..
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end largely flat, off highs on U.S..

text.p: Swedish shares ended largely flat on Friday after coming off highs in the afternoon when U.S. employment statistics pushed interest rates higher.
Wall Street opening lower further depressed a volatile Stockholm market.
The exchange's general index rose 0.04 percent to 2,611.52 in relatively modest turnover of 3.42 billion crowns.

"When market players started analysing the figures, they concluded that these were signs of a fairly strong economy," a dealer said. "When they saw New York falling, the negative sentiment became stronger."
Telecoms group Ericsson dropped four crowns to 246.5 and drugs major Astra edged 0.5 lower to 347.

Investment group Investor ended 5.5 crowns higher at 339 after news Percy Barnevik, one of Sweden's top business leaders, will take over as chairman. Incentive, another Wallenberg family company, leaped 16 crowns to 505.
Appliance maker Electrolux rose seven to 464.
Banks were mixed with Nordbanken up four to 246 and S-E-Banken rising 0.5 to 80, while Swedbank and Foreningsbanken slipped.
